# Ryth Vara, REALTOR® in Monroe County and Northampton County, Pennsylvania

> Ryth Vara is a bilingual (English and Spanish) REALTOR® with Real of Pennsylvania, licensed in Pennsylvania (license RS380174), serving Monroe County and Northampton County (the Poconos and the Lehigh Valley), plus Allentown. Specialties: luxury real estate, real estate investors and Spanish-speaking buyers and sellers.
